feed.subtitle: Research papers and global crypto regulation, at a glance
feed.rights: Explanations and summaries are generated by AI from the original text. Dates, rates and amounts are checked against the source, but errors are still possible, so always rely on the original. Nothing here is legal, tax or investment advice.

entry.title: ADGM publishes guidance on crypto mining, the region's first such guidance from an international financial centre
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The ADGM Registration Authority has published guidance on crypto mining activities in and from ADGM, issued under section 23 of the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025. The guidance treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA rather than a regulated financial service. It takes a technology-neutral approach covering Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms. This is the first phase, with a regulatory framework to be developed and consulted on later.

entry.title: Circular on good practices for virtual asset service providers' public disclosures
entry.summary: Circular: Good practices for VASP’s public disclosures VARA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto VARA issued this circular based on a thematic review of public disclosures by licensed virtual asset service providers, setting out characteristics of good practice. It stresses treating disclosure as an ongoing compliance obligation and gives examples on pricing methodology, order routing and per-asset information. The circular is illustrative only and does not change any existing regulations or licence conditions.

entry.title: ADGM Regulator Fines MCA Auditors and Its Audit Principal USD 88,000 Over Audit Failings
entry.summary: ADGM’s RA Imposes Financial Penalties of USD 88,000 Against MCA Auditors and its Registered Audit Principal for Audit Failings 23 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 23, 2026 The ADGM Registration Authority (RA) imposed financial penalties totalling USD 88,000 on MCA Auditors and Advisors LLP and its Audit Principal for audit failures found during an RA inspection. The inspection found deficiencies in an audit of an ADGM-registered company, including risk assessment, fraud risk, group audit requirements, communications with those charged with governance, and evidence over material areas. Limited evidence of the Audit Principal's involvement was also found.

entry.title: Pantheon opens Abu Dhabi office and names Middle East head
entry.summary: Pantheon expands Middle East presence with new Abu Dhabi office and senior regional appointment ADGM / FSRA · Sep 30, 2026 Pantheon, a global private markets firm, has opened its first office in ADGM, Abu Dhabi's international financial centre, and appointed Firas Mallah as Managing Director and Head of Middle East. The firm says the office will deepen its relationships with investors across the GCC and brings its global footprint to 13 locations.

entry.title: FSRA Warns Public About Suspected Fraud by E-Community
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts Public to Suspected Fraudulent Scheme by E-Community ADGM / FSRA · Sep 30, 2026 The Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM warns the public about a suspected fraudulent scheme run through the website e-community.co by an entity named E-Community, which has made false and misleading claims. The FSRA states that only FSRA-authorised firms may undertake Regulated Activities in ADGM and advises against dealing with any firm until its authorisation is verified.

entry.title: ADGM Registration Authority Publishes 2026-2027 Regulatory Priorities
entry.summary: ADGM’s Registration Authority Publishes Regulatory Priorities for 2026-2027 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 1, 2026 The Registration Authority of ADGM has published its Regulatory Priorities for 2026-2027, setting out ten focus areas for monitoring, supervision and enforcement. The document also includes key performance indicators to measure progress in each area. It is intended to help firms and stakeholders anticipate supervisory attention and allocate compliance resources.

entry.title: Eurazeo Opens Abu Dhabi Office to Expand Middle East Presence
entry.summary: Eurazeo Opens an Office in Abu Dhabi, Reinforcing Its Commitment To The Middle East ADGM / FSRA · Oct 1, 2026 Eurazeo, a European private markets asset manager, has opened its first Middle East office in ADGM, Abu Dhabi. Led by Managing Director Adrien Pinelli, the office will serve as a strategic hub for the group's regional activities. It aims to deepen ties with Gulf investors and support portfolio companies expanding in the region.

entry.title: ADGM FSRA seeks feedback on proposed DeFi risk management guidance
entry.summary: ADGM FSRA Invites Industry Feedback on Proposed DeFi Risk Management Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 6, 2026 · Crypto The ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority published Consultation Paper No. 5 of 2026 on proposed DeFi risk management guidance. It sets out expectations for how authorised persons and recognised bodies should identify, assess, monitor and manage risks from engaging with DeFi protocols and venues, covering governance, due diligence, financial crime controls and client asset safeguards. Comments are due by 30 November 2026 and may be sent to fsra.consultation@adgm.com.

entry.title: Capital Group obtains FSRA licence in Abu Dhabi to expand Middle East presence
entry.summary: Capital Group secures FSRA licence in Abu Dhabi as it expands in the Middle East ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 Capital Group, a major active investment manager, announced it has received a Financial Services Permission from the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM. The approval allows it to operate as a regulated investment manager conducting trading, investment management and distribution within ADGM. The firm previously announced in May 2026 plans for its first Middle East office in Abu Dhabi and has relocated staff from North America, Europe and Asia.

entry.title: New Mountain Capital opens an Abu Dhabi office in ADGM to deepen Gulf client ties
entry.summary: New Mountain Capital Opens Abu Dhabi Office in ADGM, Strengthening Long-Term Commitment to the Region ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 New Mountain Capital, a New York-based alternative investment firm, announced the establishment of New Mountain Capital Middle East Limited in ADGM after receiving FSRA approval to conduct regulated activities. The office is led by Shehreyar Hameed as Senior Executive Officer and aims to strengthen relationships with GCC investors.

entry.title: ADGM Registration Authority consultation on enhanced strata regulations
entry.summary: ADGM Registration Authority Publishes Consultation Paper on Enhanced Strata Regulations 07 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 The ADGM Registration Authority has issued a consultation paper seeking public feedback on proposed new Strata Regulations to repeal and replace the Strata Title Regulations 2015. The proposals include automatic establishment of an Owners' Association upon registration of a strata plan, appointment of a licensed Owners' Association Manager, and Registrar approval of annual budgets. The consultation closes on 22 October 2026.

entry.title: Numou and Comera Financial Holding Partner to Expand Financing and Payment Solutions for UAE SMEs
entry.summary: Numou and Comera Financial Holding Partner to Expand Financing and Payment Solutions for UAE SMEs 07 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 7, 2026 Numou, an ADGM subsidiary, and Comera Financial Holding, part of Abu Dhabi's Royal Group, signed a partnership agreement. Comera's financing, business account opening and digital payment products will be offered on Numou's digital marketplace. The collaboration covers working capital, supply chain finance and digital payment solutions for UAE SMEs.

entry.title: FSRA warns public about false, misleading claims by Takeo Investments
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts Public to False and Misleading claims made by Takeo Investments 08 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 8, 2026 The FSRA of ADGM warns the financial community and public about false and misleading claims by an entity or purported entity named Takeo Investments. The website it previously operated is no longer operational. The FSRA says the firm may have falsely claimed association with ADGM, potentially misleading investors into believing it is licensed to operate there. The FSRA advises not dealing with any firm until its authenticity and FSRA permission are verified.

entry.title: ADGM regulator consults on changes to fees and general rulebooks
entry.summary: ADGM FSRA Launches Consultation on Revisions to its Fees and General Rulebooks 09 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 9, 2026 The ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority published Consultation Paper No. 6 of 2026 proposing amendments to its Fees and General Rulebooks. The proposals update fees for Recognised Bodies and MTF and OTF operators, introduce a supervision fee for securities on the Official List, and increase the fee for late Regulatory Filings. The consultation closes on 6 November 2026.

entry.title: ADGM regulator fines PKF Accountants and its audit principal USD 100,000 for audit failings
entry.summary: ADGM’s Registration Authority Imposes Financial Penalties of USD 100,000 against PKF Accountants and its Registered Audit Principal for Audit Failings 09 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 9, 2026 The ADGM Registration Authority has imposed financial penalties totalling USD 100,000 on PKF Accountants and Business Advisers LLP and its registered audit principal, Ms Saranga Omprakash Lalwani, for audit failings identified during an inspection. The RA found that an audit was not conducted and reported in accordance with International Standards on Auditing and that due skill, care and diligence was not exercised. Deficiencies included fraud risk assessment, obtaining sufficient audit evidence, audit documentation, and evidence of the audit principal's involvement.

entry.title: 3iQ Receives In-Principle Approval for ADGM Category 4 License
entry.summary: 3iQ Receives In-Principle Approval from Abu Dhabi’s IFC 12 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 12, 2026 · Crypto 3iQ's UAE subsidiary, 3iQ Middle East Ltd, has received in-principle approval for a Category 4 license from the Financial Services Authority (FSRA) of ADGM, the Abu Dhabi international financial centre. The company says this is part of its aim to be regulated and present in major digital asset hubs worldwide.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi delegation to present investment opportunities in London
entry.summary: Abu Dhabi delegation to showcase Abu Dhabi’s investment opportunities in London 13 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 13, 2026 Abu Dhabi bodies including ADCCI, ADGM and ADIO will hold high-level investment and business engagements in London to showcase opportunities and strengthen private-sector partnerships. Events include the third London edition of the Abu Dhabi Investment Forum and ADCCI's Global Executive Connect programme, covering financial services, technology, healthcare, energy and trade.

entry.title: Pretium opens Abu Dhabi office to expand Middle East presence
entry.summary: Pretium Expands Middle East Presence with Abu Dhabi Office 14 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 14, 2026 Pretium, an investment firm with about $70 billion in assets under management, has opened an office in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM). The office aims to place the firm closer to regional institutional investors and expand investment opportunities in the region. It will be led by Basim Habib and Dietrich Heidtmann.

entry.title: Advent opens Abu Dhabi office in ADGM, expanding international reach
entry.summary: Advent opens office in Abu Dhabi, further extending its international reach 21 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 21, 2026 Global private equity investor Advent has opened a new office in ADGM, the international financial centre of Abu Dhabi, to extend its platform into the Middle East. The office, headed by Managing Director Mehdi Iraqi, will deepen investor engagement, support existing portfolio companies and explore investment opportunities. Advent now has 18 offices across 15 countries.

entry.title: ADGM RA Consults on Business Centre Regulatory Framework
entry.summary: ADGM RA Publishes Consultation Paper on Enhanced Business Centre Framework 15 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 15, 2026 The ADGM Registration Authority has issued a consultation paper seeking public feedback on proposed amendments to Commercial Licensing Regulations, Controlled Activities Rules, Conditions of Licence and Branch Registration Rules, and Fees Rules. The proposals would make business centre services a controlled activity and set specific licence conditions for providers, aiming to protect tenants and support continuity of premises and registered office arrangements. The consultation closes on 6 November 2026.
